targets.baseline_commit_message: audio-transcription: five launch-video transcript readers, moved byte for byte

preserve: only quotes of videos whose caption source starts with whisper are checked, each unique (video, stamp, quote) once
a quote is found as the exact run of its lower-case letter-and-digit words in the word-timed transcript
each hit says its word times and whether its first word starts inside the cited window
a quote not found, or a hit outside its window, is a problem
allowed_deltas: the window's length is an argument (45 seconds by default)
the last line is {"result": {quotes, problems, hits}}
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
